action.command: bash -c 'VFILE="$HOME/.kiro/governance-version.json"; [ ! -f "$VFILE" ] && echo "Governance Kit not installed. Run bootstrap." && exit 0; SYNCED=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open(\"$VFILE\")).get(\"synced_at\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); [ -z "$SYNCED" ] && exit 0; DAYS_AGO=$(python3 -c "from datetime import datetime,timezone; synced=datetime.fromisoformat(\"$SYNCED\".replace(\"Z\",\"+00:00\")); delta=(datetime.now(timezone.utc)-synced).days; print(delta)" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [ "$DAYS_AGO" -gt 14 ] && echo "Governance config not synced for ${DAYS_AGO} days. Run: ~/.kiro/governance-sync"; true'
